subject: Welcome to Redwood — book a demo

From: No Reply <no-reply@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@startupx.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — book a demo

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference! We’ve reserved a quick demo slot for you so you can see the platform in action and get matched with the right engineer for your use case.

Book a time with our team here: https://redwood.ai/schedule/XYZ?ref=signup

What to expect:
- 20–45 minute demo (you can request an engineer-led deep dive)
- Short checklist to help us prepare (attached)
- Option to connect to SSO/KMS questions during the call

Attachment: getting-started-guide.pdf (PDF, 380KB)

If you have any immediate scheduling constraints, reply to this email and we’ll make sure someone from our sales team helps you pick a slot.

—
Redwood Inference team
support@redwood.com

Hi —

Thanks for the heads up. I clicked the link but we have a couple of constraints on our side (engineer availability + SSO questions). Ideally we'd have an engineer on the call. Our windows next week (US/PST):

- Tue 24 Nov — 10:00–11:00
- Wed 25 Nov — 14:00–16:00

If you can offer a 45-minute slot with an engineer, that would be ideal. I’ve attached a short doc with our SSO/KMS notes so you can route this to the right person.

Attachment: startupx_requirements.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Director of Platform
StartupX
